method: Banks loaded read-only in a node vm (production-scripts/load-banks.js). An item is a copy when its normalized stem and choice set match an item already planned (no writing; it becomes an alias after its own checks), adapt when it shares a lineage id with one (a rewrite: start from that explainer), otherwise new. Batches are about 25 items of one bank and section, cut at subtopic (RC: passage) boundaries. Visual types come from the subtopic and the item features (production-plan.md, section 4).

groups.title: Full-Length Test 1 (free public tier)
groups.why: The one full practice test every visitor can take; the first explainers most students will ever see.

groups.title: Diagnostics
groups.why: Every new student starts here (free tier). diagnostic.html is frozen to one 60-item form drawn from Practice Test 3, plus the four engine diagnostics.

groups.title: Full-Length Tests 2 to 4
groups.why: Timed tests coached students take in the Test phase; explainers appear in the review after each test.
groups.templatesNote: same six PAT templates, new seeds: a 12-item sample per template is re-checked, nothing new to write

groups.title: Practice Tests 1 to 3 (Sciences and QR sections)
groups.why: Section-length practice tests; once explained, prometric-mock.html moves onto the shared player.

groups.title: The Climb (10 mini-tests)
groups.why: Mixed 40-item mini-tests used through the Blend phase; already the best-explained bank (median 81 words), so writers start from its stored explanations.

groups.title: Reading Comprehension bank (passages outside the full tests)
groups.why: Every RC item already has proof lines and distractor notes; this is mostly migration to families and the evidence picture.

groups.title: DAT-format sets: QR formats, OChem 2026 set, Ace bank
groups.why: The newest DAT-style items (2026 OChem spec; QR comparison, sufficiency, data and word formats).

groups.title: Section engines: QR, Gen Chem, OChem 1000
groups.why: The banks behind lesson checks, warm-ups and section drills; most pool and game items are copies or rewrites of these.

groups.title: Pool, games, OChem engine and lesson checks
groups.why: What remains: pool Bio, OChem engine items, game copies (mostly aliases), the Bio hub retrieval cards and small lesson sets.

groups.title: Retold courses, trick-video checks, QR pacing pages
groups.why: These already carry per-choice notes and a scene picture; the work is house-rule migration (families, "wrong" wording) rather than writing.
